services.name: Fin Whale
services.desc: We will primarily be focusing on finding whales on these trips, but we always keep our eyes out for a variety of dolphin/porpoise species along with sea lions and birds. From Nov/Dec - April, California Gray Whales will be the targeted whale species; although we will never pass by a cooperating whale of another species. May-October generally provides a good chance of seeing Fin Whales, Humpback Whales, and Minke Whales. During the summertime in particular, when the water is warmest, is when we have our best chances of seeing Blue Whales. services.name: sunset cruise
services.desc: The Sunset Scenic Whale and Dolphin Watch Sunset Cruise trip is 2.5 hours in duration. We will depart from Seaforth Landing typically at 5:00 (check the scheduled availability). The cruise will start with a cruise out to the open ocean to look for marine mammals and other wildlife. We typically arrive back to the dock at 7:30pm. If the weather makes the ocean unsafe or unenjoyable we will limit this Sunset Cruise to stay inside Mission Bay. The Legacy has a fully stocked snack and beverage bar. The vessel is an 80 ft fiberglass boat with indoor and outdoor seating, a snack and beverage bar, and restrooms. Tours also include sightings of dolphins, sea lions, and a variety of birds.
